summary: Frontend-only testing of TallyDekho Expo app. Tested full auth flow, home screen modules, FAB modal, header navigation, and all individual screens. Core flows work well. One critical bug found: Quick Actions modal items navigate to unmatched routes.

ui_bugs.issue: QA items navigate to unmatched routes (e.g., /sales/invoice, /sales/quotation) which show 'Unmatched Route - Page could not be found'. These sub-routes don't exist as screens. Routes in mockData QUICK_ACTIONS point to non-existent screens.
Tab bar items (Home, Stocks, Ledger, Reports) do not have testID attributes, making automated testing unreliable. Only the FAB has testID='central-fab'.

Individual screens (/sales, /purchase, /voucher, /settings, /sales/register, /sales/order, /purchase/register, /voucher/payment) render correctly but none have testID attributes on their root containers.

integration_issues.flow: Quick Actions Modal → Item Press → Navigate
integration_issues.issue: Modal closes and navigates but destination routes are unmatched. QUICK_ACTIONS in mockData maps items to routes like /sales/invoice, /sales/quotation, /purchase/bill etc. that have no corresponding screen files.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix QUICK_ACTIONS routes in mockData.ts - items currently navigate to non-existent routes (/sales/invoice, /sales/quotation, etc.). Either create these screens or update routes to existing screens like /sales/register, /sales/order
LOW: Add testID attributes to tab bar items in (tabs)/_layout.tsx renderTab function
LOW: Add testID attributes to individual screen root containers (sales, purchase, voucher, settings)
critical_code_review_comments: QUICK_ACTIONS in mockData.ts contains routes that don't exist as file-based routes in the /app/ directory. This causes Expo Router 'Unmatched Route' error when QA items are pressed.
Tab bar items lack testID - makes testing and accessibility harder
storeToken in AuthContext.tsx calls both localStorage AND AsyncStorage on web - redundant double write (line 10), but functionally works

success_rate.frontend: 85% - auth flow, home screen, module cards, header avatar, individual screens all work; QA modal navigation broken

context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth bypass: set localStorage.setItem('auth_token', 'mock_token_123') and navigate to root. Full auth flow: phone 9876543210 → OTP (any 6 digits) → fill full-name-input → check terms-checkbox → register-login-btn → skip-sync-btn → home. All top-level module screens work. QA modal navigation is broken (unmatched routes).
rca_of_issue: QA modal items use routes from QUICK_ACTIONS in /app/frontend/src/data/mockData.ts. These routes (e.g., /sales/invoice, /sales/quotation) have no corresponding file in /app/frontend/app/sales/. The existing screens are /sales/register and /sales/order. Fix: update QUICK_ACTIONS item routes in mockData.ts to map to existing screens, or create the missing screen files.
